name: Linktree
whatYouLose: A template marketplace and built-in commerce integrations
Turnkey analytics dashboards and audience retargeting tools
No-code editing for many nontechnical creators
prompt: Build a lightning-fast personal link-in-bio page with a profile image, bio, social icons, reorderable link cards, optional featured link, scheduled visibility, and theme controls. Include a password-protected admin page, first-party click counts in SQLite, UTM preservation, accessible focus states, a 100/100 performance target, Open Graph metadata, and a one-command deployment guide. Use Astro server rendering and vanilla JavaScript only. Do not load third-party analytics or fonts at runtime.
notes: This is a textbook yes: narrow surface area, simple data, and your custom page will usually be faster and more distinctive.
